title: upfly init --json: the result
description: The last line upfly init --json prints once it has written its files: the config written and why, and with --agents what it did with each file it points the coding agents at. Progress lines come before it (events.json). When a config file already exists and --agents was not given, init writes nothing and prints an error line with exit code 3 and reason CONFIG_EXISTS instead (events.json); an instruction file holding an Upfly block with no end stops it the same way, with reason UPFLY_BLOCK_UNCLOSED.

file.description: The config file written, or null when --agents found one already there and kept it.

config.description: What the config file written holds, or null when none was written.

reasons.description: Why each setting was written, or left out; empty when no config was written.

value.description: The folder or format written, or null when the setting was left out.

ties.description: Folders Upfly could not choose between, since they resolve the site's paths equally well. None of them is written; add the right one to publicDirs. Absent when there is no tie.

dir.description: The folder holding the pages whose root-relative paths tie, relative to the project; empty for the project folder itself.

agents.description: With --agents: each instruction file and each copy of the Upfly skill it looked at, and what it did. Absent without --agents.

instructions.description: AGENTS.md, then a CLAUDE.md and a GEMINI.md the project already had.

action.description: created: the file did not exist; added: the block was added at its end; updated: the block between its markers was replaced; unchanged: it already held the current block; skipped: left as it is, with why.

why.description: Why a file was skipped, such as a CLAUDE.md that imports AGENTS.md.
